CSVTableDelimiter.description: Field delimiter for embedded CSV tables: a literal (e.g. ',') or 'auto' to detect one from the first line.

CSVTableFirstRowHeader.description: Render the first CSV row as a table header (<th>) rather than a data row.

CSVTableMaxBytes.description: Maximum embedded CSV size in bytes; larger files render an error notice instead of a table.

CSVTableMaxRows.description: Maximum number of CSV rows rendered; more rows render an error notice.

CSVTableMaxCols.description: Maximum number of CSV columns rendered; more columns render an error notice.
